info.name: GoRest Users API Tests
info.description:
API test collection for https://gorest.co.in/public/v2/users covering:

Scenario 1: Create a new user (Name, Gender, Email, Status) and verify the returned id is numeric.
Scenario 2: Verify the status of the first entry in the users list is either 'active' or 'inactive'.

Before running, set the 'accessToken' variable in the environment to a valid GoRest personal access token (get one at https://gorest.co.in/my-account/access-tokens after signing in).
